com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AgentGraphNode

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AgentGraphNode

  • public final class AgentGraphNode
extends java.lang.Object
    A node in an AgentGraphDefinition, wrapping a single agent config and its outgoing edges to other nodes.

    Nodes are retrieved from a graph definition via AgentGraphDefinition.getNode(String), AgentGraphDefinition.rootNode(), etc. Instances are immutable.
